thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: paging: p99 latency spike + streaming stalls observed for /v1/stream (us-west) — alert fired: inference.latency.p99 > 1.2s for 5m. Rolled to P1.

ashley_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing traces and looking at control-plane deps (auth/token-store + config fetch). @sam_backend can you confirm whether any deploys happened in the last hour?

sam_backend: no deploys from infra in the last 2h. seeing a sharp uptick in failed token-store queries (timeout / serialization errors) around 03:12 UTC. stacktraces show auth-service getting 504s from token-store read.

sam_backend: logs snippet:
```
E 03:12:34 auth-service GET /token/validate 504 "SELECT * FROM token_store WHERE user_id=..." timeout=12000ms
E 03:12:35 config-fetcher GET /configs route=streaming err="rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded"
```

natalie_sre: I'm seeing the same in the DB metrics — connection waiters spiking, p95 query latency for token_store ~2.4s, and >90% of fast-paths backed up. Could be a bad query pattern or a hot shard. Paging DB oncall.

ashley_oncall: @deploy-bot any recent config flag changes? specifically around feature flags for streaming or remote config TTLs?

deploy-bot: Recent rollout: featureflag/stream-remote-ttl reduced from 5m -> 15s at 02:58 UTC (gradual rollout, 50%). No full rollback yet.

john_ml: if remote config TTL dropped to 15s, config-fetch rate would multiply and hit token_store for auth checks more frequently. that could blow connection pools.

emily_support: any customer impact? Support queue shows a handful (~5) of streaming sessions complaining about stalls, some ingest requests failed with 504. No major account-level alerts yet.

ashley_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) revert TTL change (roll back feature flag) 2) enable cached-config fallback for streaming route 3) bump DB conn pool for token_store 4) throttle background config refreshers. Let's run 1 and 2 immediately.

sam_backend: executing rollback of featureflag/stream-remote-ttl now (canary -> disabled).

sam_backend: command:
```
# revert feature flag rollout
kubectl exec -it rollout-manager -- curl -X POST http://ff-service.local/rollback -d '{"flag":"stream-remote-ttl","to":"5m"}'
```

natalie_sre: while that runs, I'm flipping streaming route to cached-mode: set env STREAM_CONFIG_MODE=cached on the api-gateway pods. patching now.

natalie_sre: patch command:
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment api-gateway -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"STREAM_CONFIG_MODE","value":"cached"}]}]}}}}'
```

john_ml: also recommend adding short in-memory token cache in auth-service as a hotfix (safe TTL ~30s) — reduces token_store reads. I'll open a small PR.

maria_product: we should prepare a short customer note if errors persist. emily, can you draft a quick status line for impacted customers? mention degraded streaming, team investigating, ETA 30m.

emily_support: on it. draft: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls affecting a small subset of requests in US-West. We're rolling back a recent config TTL change and enabling cached config; we expect improvement within ~15-30 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

ashley_oncall: DB oncall confirmed they increased max_connections for token_store and restarted a couple of read replicas to clear long queries. monitoring shows connection waiters dropping.

sam_backend: feature flag rollback completed at 03:22 UTC. patch to gateway applied at 03:24 UTC. auth-service token cache PR opened: https://git.internal/r/tree/1234 (small change, tested locally).

natalie_sre: metrics: p95 down from 900ms -> 260ms, p99 from 1.6s -> 420ms over last 5m. streaming stalls count decreasing, tail latency improving.

ashley_oncall: good. keep throttling aggressive refreshers for another 30m. john, can you coordinate the token-cache rollout? prefer a quick canary in us-west1 only.

john_ml: will do. canary deploy via CI now. attaching commands and a small rollout plan in the PR.

emily_support: sending customer status update now. "Mitigation in progress; we rolled back a config change and enabled cached config for streaming. Observed latency improvements; monitoring continues."

maria_product: please add a bullet for product review — the TTL change rationale should be re-evaluated; we may have to gate this kind of low-latency TTL with a staged traffic ramp.

ashley_oncall: handing off to natalie for the next 2 hours of watch and follow-ups. natalie, please capture timeline for postmortem (include feature flag rollout, token_store contention, DB connections, and recommended alert tuning).

natalie_sre: taking handoff. I will compile the timeline and open a postmortem draft in #postmortems in the next 2 hours. immediate action items: 1) revert TTL permanently until we have a rollout plan, 2) add token-store waiters alarm at 5m, 3) add a canary for TTL changes that monitors DB connection metrics.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated severity=partial customer-impact=degraded-services next-step=postmortem_assigned assignee=natalie_sre

ashley_oncall: thanks team. closing the active pager; continue monitoring and please file any follow-up bugs/PRs against the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

maria_product: noted — planning a short retro with SRE/Eng/Product tomorrow to tighten rollout controls.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 03:36 UTC. reminder: create postmortem within 48h and tag with #severity-p1 if root cause shows systemic rollout gap.
